Thank you for your feedback. We’re sorry to hear that you felt unsupported when you contacted the practice regarding your travel vaccinations.

Our travel vaccination service does require at least six weeks’ notice before travel. This is in place to ensure there is enough time to safely assess your needs, arrange any necessary vaccines, and allow them to be effective before you travel. We understand this can be frustrating, especially when you’re unsure whether any vaccines are required.

Our reception team aim to provide accurate information based on clinical guidance and practice policy, but we are sorry if the conversation came across as lacking empathy. This is certainly not the experience we want our patients to have.

Some travel vaccinations are not provided on the NHS and are instead available through private travel clinics and pharmacies, which is why this option was mentioned.

We value your feedback and will use it to help improve how we communicate with patients. If you would like to discuss this further, please contact the practice and ask to speak with the Practice Manager, who will be happy to review your concerns.

Kind regards,
